name: Topoisomerase-I inhibitors (and ADC payloads)
author: Jude Gomila
message: Editing pass: every TL;DR and summary stands alone

fields.before: "Drugs that jam the enzyme that untangles DNA during copying. Weak as free drugs in many cancers, but devastating when delivered by an ADC."
fields.after: "Topoisomerase-I inhibitors work by jamming the enzyme that untangles DNA during copying. They are weak as free drugs in many cancers, but devastating when delivered by an ADC."
